The gate definition is the legend of every gate, state and reason symbol. 🤖 marks an agent contributor, 👀 a reviewer and 🪆 a junction that a subproject carries. The task view shows any one task in full, the work-blockage tree what waits on what, the task assignment what each person carries, the contextual tableau a person's corner, the global tableau the whole project, the authority delegation who may accept what, the history the events and the audit where files and history disagree.

This page is drawn as the owner, who dispatches the agent, arrives from a link to one item: c74a at mockup stands open at detail with its brief, the fold that holds it stands open, and every other item rests at glance. A person who opens their own queue with no item named arrives with the first item open at detail. An agent takes no page: its dispatcher pastes the brief as text. Every work-ready item has a brief; this mockup draws one, at c74a, and gives the command for each other.
